name: 06605 · Bridgeport, CT
findings: ZIP 06605 (Bridgeport) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06605 (Bridgeport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06605 (Bridgeport) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
